precision.target: W8A8 dynamic QLinear with FP16 output
precision.target_embedding: INT8 weight times FP32 row scale to FP16

input_identity.repository_source: verify every SOURCE_LOCK.json file/hash pair before checkpoint load
input_identity.external_artifacts: hash-complete quant input manifest is required and reverified before checkpoint load

graph.name: quant_dflash_recompute
graph.shape_policy: static S divisible by 64 and at most 32767; right-padded valid prefix

gdr_effective_length.source: count nonzero attention_mask rows along S inside the graph
gdr_effective_length.semantics: call-local logical valid rows; not physical S, cumulative KV length, or MTP accepted_tokens

compiler.soc_policy: exact 310P variant required; generic Ascend310P rejected

runtime.memory: persistent pinned host and device buffers
runtime.synchronization: one stream synchronization per OM invocation

claim_boundary: Host and fake-ACL tests do not prove AIR export, OM conversion, physical 310P correctness, or latency. Those gates require the real locked target environment.
